reviewFlags.issue: Not MIT/OSI license. Package metadata directs to README; installed LICENSE.md says all rights reserved and links Anthropic legal terms. Official README says use of SDK, including products/services offered to end users, is governed by Anthropic Commercial Terms, except separately licensed components.

The install includes a separate 262 MB executable package under its own SEE LICENSE IN LICENSE.md declaration. Its license file also reserves all rights and points to Anthropic legal terms. Do not treat the SDK wrapper as MIT or assume root project MIT overrides these terms.

Installed package.json declares MIT but its installed npm artifact has no LICENSE/NOTICE/COPYING file. The upstream repository root license is Apache-2.0 while the JS package manifest declares MIT. Resolve package-scoped license and ensure applicable license text is distributed before treating the MIT obligation as fully evidenced.

sources.method: top-level LICENSE, LICENCE, NOTICE, COPYING, LICENSES files; non-empty check; no semantic license text audit for every package
